task.description: Start all required backend services for WF02-iss202 TEST-RUNNER: docker-compose up -d db db_test keycloak. Wait for health checks: docker-compose ps (all services healthy), GET http://localhost:8081/health/ready (Keycloak), psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c 'SELECT 1' (test DB). Run zig build migrate to apply pending migrations. Return PASS only when all services are healthy and zig build migrate exits 0.
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose ps shows all services healthy

result.summary: All backend services started and verified healthy. Database migrations applied successfully.
